pictures.author: Carole Raddato
pictures.observations: Whole960x636 low oblique: pale fluted columns, two leafy capital registers, partial curved entablature and annular ceiling with recessed coffers. Roofless darker rubble cella behind, large brick relieving arch/blocked masonry patch. Steel restraint rods between some columns. Open-ended surviving colonnade, no complete roof.

pictures.author: Oursana
pictures.observations: Whole500x750 view from southwest context: bare cella wall/open large pale-framed rectangular doorway at left, surviving columns/entablature at right, tall pale-framed rectangular opening seen behind columns. Roofless uneven cella top. Circular podium above host cliff/retaining structure, separate neighboring temple columns to left. Modern restaurant umbrellas remain context.

pictures.author: Carole Raddato
pictures.observations: Whole960x636 close detail resolves the concrete capital/frieze coverage gap: two rows of acanthus, oversized floral abacus motifs, flat-ended shaft flutes, horned skull/fruit-swag/rosette frieze and broad stepped cornice without modillions. Recessed coffered annular soffit. Use original simplified geometric ornament, not copied texture pixels.

contextOnlyPicture.author: Anna Eden86
contextOnlyPicture.observations: Whole960x433 distant cliff/town context. Temple is too small for detailed construction; do not use it to invent fine inventory.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Standing Temple of Vesta at Tivoli: roofless hollow dark-rubble cella with original simplified reticulate masonry patches with real southwest doorway and southeast window, blocked eastern relieving arch, ten surviving pale fluted Corinthian columns on the eastern/southern arc, partial curved entablature/annular coffered soffit and circular occupied podium with short southwest approach. Original simplified Tivoli-style floral capitals and horned skull/swag/rosette frieze; small restraint rods. Neighboring Temple of the Sibyl, restaurant furniture, cliff-retaining structures and landscaping remain separate host context. No restored absent columns, complete conical roof, copied inscription/sculpture or photo atlas.
